map.name: Greenwater Strip
map.phase: blockout — route approved, no final art

units.origin: centre of the start/finish line on the surface, y = 0

apron.note: Authored run-off per edge type. Width is measured outward from halfWidth; grip applies once past halfWidth - deckMarginMetres, which is outside every racing line the route supports.

overrides.note: LINK_APRON and HANGAR_SIX are a diegetic interior. The wall is correct there, so no run-off is authored and the legacy deck-margin clamp is kept exactly.
overrides.label: HANGAR_WALL

pacing.note: approved pacing: keep the 300 km/h corner-entry figure, average about 260 km/h. Five laps lands at 2:54, inside the 2-3 minute race target; six laps would be 3:29 and overshoot it, so lapCount defaults to 5.

lapBoard.note: board is data-driven; no lap count is baked into gantry geometry or texture

edgeTypes.C: open edge, 6 m hatched run-off then water or drop, triggers recovery

startFinish.distinctFrom: checkpoint pylons: full-span roof beam, rotating amber beacons, chequered deck band, world-space lap board, sub-bass hit on cross

checkpoints.name: Hangar Six interior, under the crane
Spillway apron, top of the Sweep
End of Fuel Row, T10 braking board

hazards.note: P15: -8.0 -> -10.2 m. The deck exemption for hazards was revoked; nothing stands on the racing surface. Half-width here is 9.50 m, so the deck clears at 10.00 m and this sits 0.20 m beyond it, at the foot of the Hangar Six frame line.

P11 moved this +7.0 -> +8.4 m to leave the drivable clamp. P15: +8.4 -> +10.2 m, because the deck exemption for hazards was revoked entirely. Half-width here is 9.50 m, so the deck clears at 10.00 m and this sits 0.20 m beyond it.
P15: -8.5 -> -10.2 m, off the deck entirely. Half-width here is 9.50 m, so the deck clears at 10.00 m and the coil sits 0.20 m beyond it, against the hangar frame line.
P15: +9.0 -> +10.5 m, off the deck entirely. Half-width here is 9.79 m, so the deck clears at 10.29 m and the coil sits 0.21 m beyond it, on the Canopy Passage run-off.

timeOfDay.note: P4a lap-based drift. lapProgress is the whole race (lap N of total, 0 at the green light, 1 at the flag). Every value is a MULTIPLIER over the sector palette, never a replacement, so sector identity survives the drift: the ramp only says how far through the day the race has got. Stop 0 is the identity stop, so reduced motion and the menu (no lap data) both collapse to no drift at all.
timeOfDay.rimNote: the navigation rim light keeps its accepted colour language and is NOT tinted; the sky dome accent band takes the ramp at reduced strength so the horizon line still drifts with the rest of the sky.
